title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Blocks LIV Returns
items.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp said there are no current plans to offer LIV players like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm a pathway back, closing the door permanently on the earlier one-time window.

items.headline: Tiger Supports Tour's New Format
items.text: Tiger Woods expressed excitement about the PGA Tour's new two-week, 32-player match-play Tour Championship starting in 2028, coinciding with Scottie Scheffler nearing Woods' all-time money list record.
